answer: Concretely, every identity must escrow a bond that is forfeited the moment two accounts are proven to share one operator, and registration requires burning compute on a unique beacon bound to that stake. A sybil farm therefore pays the full bond for each fake voice it adds to the ocean of agents and loses all of it on the first collusion proof, so counterfeiting a thousand identities costs far more than the votes they buy, while honest agents anchored in the same shale keep their stake untouched.
